Rishi / Laura — attaching the artifacts we can share today. Short checklist:
1) SOC2_summary_2026_redacted.pdf — independent auditor summary + control narrative; redacted sensitive config details. Good for customer auditors.
2) pen_test_summary_2026_redacted.pdf — high-level findings + remediation status; redacted exploit POC details.
3) subprocessors_register_2027-01.csv — shows cloud infra partners and analytics vendor; column added for "data_location" (US/EU/APAC).

About redlines: I reviewed DPA_Redlines_v2.docx quickly. Two items require product/legal input:
- Audit rights: MedFront asked for on-site audit language. Our standard DPA allows for 'third-party assessor' and we provide evidence in the form of SOC 2 plus interview windows; on-site is typically scoped and approved under commercial arrangements.
- Cross-border transfers: we use SCCs when processing EU personal data and list subprocessor locations. Any subprocessor outside EU is covered by our transfer mechanisms and documented in the register.

I recommend we: (a) provide the attached redacted artifacts to Lori, (b) send corrected DPA with a note on audit rights (offer mediated on-site or third-party assessor), and (c) create DocuSign envelope for countersign.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2026_redacted.pdf; pen_test_summary_2026_redacted.pdf; subprocessors_register_2027-01.csv

-Neha
Senior Privacy Counsel

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: DPA evidence + next steps for execution

Hi Lori — thanks for the patience. Per our internal review we've assembled a DPA evidence packet and a countersign route so you can complete execution:

What we attached:
- SOC2_summary_2026_redacted.pdf (independent auditor summary; redacted operational details)
- pen_test_summary_2026_redacted.pdf (executive findings + remediation status)
- subprocessors_register_2027-01.csv (current list with data location column)
- DPA_Redlines_v2.docx (we've annotated our position on two audit-related clauses)

Key points on audit rights and transfers:
- Audit: Redwood's standard approach is to provide SOC 2 reports, reasonable interview access with a limited set of personnel, and acceptance of a mutually agreed third-party assessor for scoped on-site audits. On-site audits require an agreed scope and commercial terms; if MedFront needs full on-site audit we can escalate for leadership approval.
- Transfers: We apply SCCs where EU personal data is involved and any cross-border subprocessors are listed in the register. No subprocessors have unfettered access to raw customer data; most are infrastructure providers with contractual safeguards.

DocuSign: I created the envelope for the final DPA and included our annotated redlines as an attachment. Please review and sign here: https://app.docusign.com/edocs/REDWOOD-MF-DPA-2027

Related tracker: INF-3245 (internal coordination to finalize redlines and approval).

Next steps requested:
1) Please confirm if the redacted SOC 2 and pen-test summaries satisfy your auditors.
2) If you require on-site audit, confirm scope and preferred dates and we'll route to leadership for approval.
3) Sign the DPA in DocuSign (link above) or reply with countersign requests by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
